web_blocks.text: What GNA Axles Does & Why It Is Under Review

web_blocks.html: GNA Axles Limited (NSE: GNA) makes forged rear axle shafts (~74.3% of sales), spindles (~17.2%), and drive shafts (~8.5%) in Punjab [1][6][10]. Its Mehtiana and Gulabgarh Jattan plants supply global Tier-1s (Dana, Meritor/Cummins, John Deere) and domestic OEMs (Mahindra, TAFE, Kubota) [7][11]. Revenue splits ~53% domestic and ~47% export [10]. After three flat years following its FY23 peak (₹1,583 Cr), H1 FY27 rebounded sharply [1]. Q1 FY27 sales rose +36.67% YoY to ₹470.44 Cr, and Q2 FY27 jumped +49.8% YoY to ₹521.15 Cr (PAT ₹44.07 Cr), lifting TTM sales to ₹1,778 Cr [1][3][4]. GNA holds `[ICRA]AA- (Stable)` credit and 0.19x debt-to-equity [1][5]. Yet 151 debtor days, 14.3% FY26 ROCE, ~80% top-10 buyer share, and a 9.96 pp promoter trim in 2026 lock business quality at CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL (`PASS_WITH_WATCH`) [1][5][12].

web_blocks.text: Dual Portfolio Verdict, Price Levels & Three-Horizon Judgment

web_blocks.html: On November 13, 2026, GNA closed at ₹580.90 in our canonical NSE/Yahoo session-close ledger (~17.2x TTM P/E; 17.05x and ₹2,496.64 Cr market cap in the TradingView snapshot at ₹576.45, 2.31x P/B) [26]. While the stock remains in a Weinstein Stage 2 uptrend (+4.05% above its 50-DMA ₹558.28 and +5.09% above its 10-week EMA approx ₹552.74, with Daily RSI(14) at 56.94 and ATR(14) at ₹26.70), it has logged 5 distribution days in the trailing 25 sessions and trails the Nifty 50 by -12.11% over 28 days (vs. +2.22% over 63 days) [26]. GNA has no NSE F&O chain (`NOT_OPTIONABLE_OR_ILLIQUID`), so we use cash equity only [26]. In Zerodha, GNA is NOT_HELD (`0` shares, `holding_shares_to_sell = 0`). Applying a disciplined 16.5x FY28E exit P/E (aligned with Automotive Axles' 15.93x TTM P/E and GNA's 14.3% ROCE, 151 debtor days, and 9.96 pp promoter trim) to ₹40.79 FY28E EPS gives a ₹673.00 Base Target [25][26]. At ₹580.90 CMP against our ₹487.49 stop, upside (₹92.10) vs. risk (₹93.41) is only 0.99:1 (<1.50:1, not actionable). Our new-capital verdict is therefore WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (`STAGE2_PULLBACK_WATCH`, `TIER_3`): stage limit bids only inside ₹549.15–₹560.00 for 1.56:1–2.01:1 asymmetry [26].

web_blocks.takeaway: At ₹580.90 CMP, GNA Axles offers only 0.99:1 Base R:R to ₹673.00 (16.5x FY28E EPS) alongside 5 distribution days and -12.11% 28-day RS, earning WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_3) until price pulls back into ₹549.15–₹560.00 (1.56:1–2.01:1 R:R) against the ₹487.49 stop.

web_blocks.html: The tactical takeaway is straightforward: GNA Axles is not a flawless, asset-light compounder, and we never pretend otherwise [1]. Its 151-day debtor cycle, 14.3% ROCE, and 2026 promoter-group stake reduction keep it in the `CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL` tier [1][12]. Yet at ~17.2x trailing earnings (17.05x in the TradingView snapshot)—well below Kross (26.31x) and Happy Forgings (50.95x)—the market is already pricing in those constraints while H1 FY27 sales surge +43% YoY [3][4][26][27].

Across all three horizons, execution discipline is strict. Short-term and medium-term investors should NOT chase ₹580.90 CMP (where 0.99:1 R:R fails our 1.50:1 hurdle) and instead place limit bids inside ₹549.15–₹560.00 (3.6%–5.5% below CMP) with a hard stop at ₹487.49 [26]. Long-term investors should keep GNA on `CYCLICAL_COMPOUNDER_WATCH` until Q3 FY27–FY28 filings prove debtor days can compress below 120 and ROCE can climb above 18%–20% [1]. Meanwhile, holding 100% of our marginal ₹1,00,000 in cash earmarked for GNA avoids overextended alternatives like Sai Life Sciences (₹1,928.80) and Automotive Axles [29].

book_paragraphs: Welcome to our institutional underwriting monograph on GNA Axles Limited. Before you and I spend ten chapters walking through Punjab forging shops, 151-day export receivables, peer valuation multiples, and multi-timeframe stock charts, let me place the complete verdict and operating rules right in front of you.

GNA Axles is a quiet, battle-tested Tier-1 specialist. Tracing its heritage back to 1946 in Bundala, Punjab, the company manufactures forged and precision-machined rear axle shafts, spindles, and drive shafts across two integrated plants at Mehtiana and Gulabgarh Jattan [6][7][8]. It counts global drivetrain leaders like Dana, Meritor (now Cummins), and John Deere alongside domestic tractor champions Mahindra and TAFE as long-standing customers, splitting revenue roughly 53% domestic and 47% export [10][11][14]. After three flat-to-soft years following its FY23 peak, H1 FY27 delivered a sharp inflection: Q1 sales jumped 36.67% YoY to ₹470.44 Cr and Q2 sales surged 49.8% YoY to ₹521.15 Cr, taking trailing-twelve-month sales to ₹1,778 Cr and PAT to ₹145 Cr [1][3][4].

Even with that momentum, our price-blind business audit rates GNA Axles as CYCLICAL_CONDITIONAL (PASS_WITH_WATCH). Why? Because 151 debtor days and 133 working-capital days lock up capital on OEM balance sheets, capping ten-year ROCE in a 14%–21% corridor (14.3% in FY26; ROE 12.2%), while top-10 customers represent ~80% of sales and promoter-group shareholding fell 9.96 percentage points between March and September 2026 [1][5][12].

When we finally unlock the November 13, 2026 canonical close of ₹580.90, we find a nuanced setup: GNA trades at ~17.2x TTM P/E (17.05x in the TradingView snapshot) with 0.19x debt-to-equity and zero equity dilution since its 2016 IPO, while sitting +4.05% above its 50-DMA (₹558.28) and +5.09% above its 10-week EMA (₹552.74) with Daily RSI(14) at 56.94 [1][9][26]. However, 5 distribution days in the last 25 sessions and -12.11% 28-day relative strength vs. Nifty 50 argue against chasing CMP [26]. Applying a stricter 16.5x FY28E exit P/E yields a ₹673.00 Base Target, leaving only 0.99:1 R:R at ₹580.90 against our ₹487.49 stop. Because GNA is NOT_HELD in our Zerodha ledger and has no NSE F&O chain, our new-capital verdict is WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_3): stage limit bids only inside ₹549.15–₹560.00 for 1.56:1–2.01:1 asymmetry.

book_subsections.title: How to Read This Monograph
paragraphs: We structured this dossier as a strict two-stage filter so that market excitement never distorts our business judgment. Chapters 1 through 6 were written completely price-blind. In those six chapters, we examined GNA's 1946 founding and 2016 IPO, broke down its rear axle, spindle, and SUV/EV product economics, traced a ₹100 revenue waterfall from alloy-steel billets to net profit, tested its OEM qualification moat against Ramkrishna Forgings, Happy Forgings, Automotive Axles, and Kross, audited management's walk-the-talk record, and followed ten years of cash flows [1][6][8][9][18][19][20][21].

Only in Chapters 7 through 9 do we unlock the November 13, 2026 canonical close of ₹580.90 [26]. In Chapter 7, we run a Reverse DCF to see what ~17.2x TTM earnings actually demands, build our Bear (₹420), Base (₹673 at 16.5x FY28E EPS), and Bull (₹785) scenarios across 4.29 Cr shares, and compare GNA against its four listed forging and axle peers [25][26][27]. In Chapter 8, we inspect the 1W, 1D, and 4H charts, showing how moving averages have stacked inside ₹549.15–₹560.00, why 5 distribution days and -12.11% 28-day RS warrant patience, and why ₹487.49 is the exact structural stop [26].

Finally, Chapter 9 puts both sides of the aisle on trial, computes a probability-weighted expected value of ₹637.75, and lays out your exact alerts and 100% capital redeployment plan—explaining why we earmark 100% cash for GNA's ₹549.15–₹560.00 support zone rather than chasing CMP or overextended alternatives like Sai Life Sciences (₹1,928.80, RSI 82.68) or Automotive Axles (79.0 RSI) [26][29].

Keep this overarching principle in mind as you read forward: you do not need a business to earn a 30% ROCE to be a profitable investment—you need the price you pay to respect its working-capital reality, and the entry level to protect your downside. Waiting for ₹549.15–₹560.00 with a ₹487.49 stop gives you both [26].

Let us also be crystal clear about why GNA earns a Tier-3 WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT verdict rather than a Tier-1 compounder badge or an immediate buy at CMP. Unlike Kross Limited (₹305.90 canonical close; ₹283.20 snapshot)—which carries negative three-year free cash flow and recent equity dilution—GNA sits on a clean 0.19x debt-to-equity balance sheet with zero dilution since 2016 [1][9][26]. At the same time, its 151-day debtor cycle, 14.3% ROCE, 5 distribution days in 25 sessions, and 0.99:1 CMP reward-to-risk require us to wait for ₹549.15–₹560.00 [1].

As you read through Chapters 1 to 9, watch how every piece of evidence connects: the Punjab forging heritage in Chapter 1, the 74.3% rear-axle mix and SUV/EV pivot in Chapter 2, the ₹100 revenue waterfall in Chapter 3, the OEM qualification moat in Chapter 4, the six leading KPIs in Chapter 5, the 10-year cash conversion audit in Chapter 6, the 16.5x FY28E valuation in Chapter 7, the 5 distribution days and ₹549.15–₹560.00 shelf in Chapter 8, and the 100% cash-redeployment playbook in Chapter 9 [1][6][8][10][26]. By the end, you will have an exact, repeatable blueprint for acting on GNA Axles without emotion.

Before turning to Chapter 1, commit the three core numbers of this dossier to memory: ₹549.15–₹560.00 is your Tier-3 cash-equity support entry zone; ₹487.49 is your non-negotiable structural stop-loss below the 40-week EMA; and ₹673.00 is your 12–18 month Base Case target (with ₹785.00 Bull and ₹420.00 Bear guardrails) [26]. Everything in the next nine chapters exists to test whether those three numbers are earned by the factory floor, the balance sheet, and the tape.

If Q3 FY27 filings confirm that debtor days stay under control (<155 days), SUV and EV shaft deliveries keep scaling, and promoter-group holdings stabilize, GNA's Stage 2 chart has everything required to resolve higher once support holds [1][4][12][26]. Until then, let us start at the beginning—in 1946 Bundala, Punjab—and earn our conviction from the ground up, keeping both our balance-sheet skepticism and our Stage 2 discipline intact across every chapter, table, and alert that follows.

book_callouts.quote: Great cyclical investing is not about chasing a 0.99:1 setup; it is about letting price come down to your support shelf where the risk-reward clears 1.50:1.
book_callouts.text: GNA Axles is NOT_HELD in Zerodha today. Waiting for Tier-3 cash-equity bids inside ₹549.15–₹560.00 against a ₹487.49 stop lifts asymmetry from 0.99:1 at ₹580.90 CMP to 1.56:1–2.01:1 toward ₹673.00 while keeping our eyes wide open on 151 debtor days and promoter-group holdings [1][12][26].
